question: By whose agency and up to what limit is the yoginī named Icchā said to extend?
premises: The yoginī named Icchā is named thus.
She is associated with the siddhas.
By supreme will she extends up to the end of Māyā.
inference: By supreme will and in association with the siddhas, the yoginī Icchā extends up to the end of Māyā.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā through the siddhas.
